0.headline: Tonbo Imaging India IPO GMP at 72% ahead of issue opening tomorrow; check key details
0.heading: Tonbo Imaging India IPO GMP at 72% ahead of issue opening tomorrow; check key details
0.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Bengaluru-based defence electronics manufacturer Tonbo Imaging India is commanding a strong grey market premium (GMP) of nearly 72 percent ahead of its launch on October 15, according to market tracking platform InvestorGain.
0.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Bengaluru-based defence electronics manufacturer Tonbo Imaging India is commanding a strong grey market premium (GMP) of nearly 72 percent ahead of its launch on October 15, according to market tracking platform InvestorGain.

The grey market premium stood at 71.43 percent on the morning of October 14, indicating strong speculative interest ahead of the public issue. However, grey market premiums are unofficial indicators and do not guarantee listing gains.

The company has fixed the price band for its Rs 852.18-crore IPO at Rs 665–700 per share. The IPO will open for subscription on October 15 and close on October 19. The anchor book for institutional investors is scheduled to open on October 14.

Read Also: Who is Tejas Sudarshan? AI startup founder who got 90 seconds to pitch to PM Modi on Chennai Metro

The allotment is expected to be finalised on October 21, while the shares are likely to list on the BSE and NSE on October 23, subject to the final issue schedule.

The public issue comprises an offer for sale (OFS) of 1,21,74,046 equity shares, with no fresh issue component. At the upper end of the price band, the issue is valued at Rs 852.18 crore, implying a company valuation of around Rs 4,010 crore.

Since the IPO is entirely an OFS, Tonbo Imaging will not receive any proceeds from the issue. Instead, the net proceeds, after applicable expenses, will go to the shareholders selling their stakes.

Promoters Arvind Kondangi Lakshmikumar, Ankit Kumar and Cecilia D’Souza, along with existing investors such as CEAQ Technologies, Timothy Guy Mitchell, Artiman Partners LLC and Ramesh Radhakrishnan, are among the shareholders offloading their holdings.

Investors can bid for a minimum of 21 equity shares and in multiples of 21 shares thereafter. At the upper end of the price band of Rs 700 per share, the minimum investment required for one lot is Rs 14,700.

Check IPO News Here

The company has reserved 50 percent of the issue for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs), 15 percent for non-institutional investors (NIIs) and 35 percent for retail individual investors.

JM Financial and IIFL Capital Services are the merchant bankers managing the IPO.

Tonbo Imaging reported a net loss of Rs 17.74 crore in the April–June quarter of FY27, while revenue stood at Rs 36 crore.

For FY26, the company’s profit after tax declined 30 percent to Rs 50.88 crore from Rs 72.76 crore in FY25. Its total income fell around 22.1 percent to Rs 369.94 crore in FY26 from Rs 474.39 crore in the previous financial year.

About Tonbo Imaging India

Incorporated in 2003, Tonbo Imaging designs and manufactures electro-optic and electronic systems for defence applications. Its product portfolio includes thermal imaging systems, weapon sights, handheld thermal imaging binoculars, targeting systems, missile seekers, fire-control systems and missile-guidance systems.

The company operates in the defence electronics segment, supplying technologies used in surveillance, reconnaissance, targeting and other military applications.

1.headline: HD Fire Protect IPO booked over 7x so far on day 2; GMP rises to 34%
1.heading: HD Fire Protect IPO booked over 7x so far on day 2; GMP rises to 34%
1.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of HD Fire Protect continued to witness strong investor interest across categories, with the issue receiving over 7 times subscription by 10:50 am on October 14, as per the NSE data.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of HD Fire Protect continued to witness strong investor interest across categories, with the issue receiving over 7 times subscription by 10:50 am on October 14, as per the NSE data.

The Rs 712.1-crore IPO received bids for 12,93,54,720 shares against 1,84,20,492 shares on offer. Non-institutional investors (NIIs) led the demand, subscribing to their allotted portion 18.97 times, while the retail investor category was subscribed 5.34 times.

In the grey market, HD Fire Protect shares were commanding a premium of nearly 34 percent on the morning of October 14, according to market tracking platform InvestorGain. Grey market premiums are unofficial indicators of investor sentiment and do not guarantee listing gains.

Read Also: Who is Tejas Sudarshan? AI startup founder who got 90 seconds to pitch to PM Modi on Chennai Metro

Read Also: From struggling café to Rs 70-crore ice cream brand: How Narayan Rao built Bengaluru's popular 'Corner House Ice Creams'

HD Fire Protect has fixed a price band of Rs 258–271 per share for the public issue, which will remain open for subscription until October 15.

Investors can bid for a minimum of 55 equity shares and in multiples of 55 shares thereafter. At the upper end of the price band, the minimum investment for retail investors stands at Rs 14,905.

The allotment of shares is expected to be finalised on October 16, while the company's shares are scheduled to list on the stock exchanges on October 21.

The IPO is entirely an offer for sale (OFS) of 2.62 crore equity shares, with no fresh issue component. Promoters Harish Narshi Dharamshi and his wife, Kusum Dharamshi, are selling their shares through the offering.

Since the issue comprises only an OFS, the company will not receive any proceeds from the IPO. After deducting offer-related expenses, the proceeds will go to the selling shareholders.

The company has reserved 50 percent of the net offer, excluding the employee portion, for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs). Non-institutional investors have been allocated 15 percent, while retail investors have been allotted 35 percent of the net offer.

HD Fire Protect has also reserved shares worth Rs 1.75 crore for eligible employees, who will receive a discount of Rs 25 per share to the final offer price.

Check IPO News Here

Ambit, Anand Rathi Advisors and IIFL Capital Services are the book-running lead managers for the issue.

HD Fire Protect reported a 6.4 percent year-on-year increase in profit to Rs 116.8 crore for the financial year ended March 2026. Revenue from operations rose 13.05 percent to Rs 489.3 crore during the same period.

For the June 2026 quarter, the company reported a profit of Rs 23.8 crore and revenue of Rs 109 crore.

The domestic market accounted for 65 percent of HD Fire Protect's revenue from operations in FY26, while international markets contributed the remaining 35 percent.

2.headline: Fusion CX IPO subscribed 5% so far on Day 1; check latest GMP
2.heading: Fusion CX IPO subscribed 5% so far on Day 1; check latest GMP
2.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Fusion CX opened today, with the issue receiving 5 percent subscription as of 10:25 am on October 14, as per the NSE data.
2.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Fusion CX opened today, with the issue receiving 5 percent subscription as of 10:25 am on October 14, as per the NSE data.

The Rs 702-crore issue received bids for 6,38,673 shares against 1,40,40,000 shares on offer. Retail investors led the demand with a 19 percent subscription, followed by non-institutional investors, whose portion was booked 4 percent.

In the grey market, Fusion CX shares were commanding a premium of 11 percent over the upper end of the IPO price band on October 14, according to market tracking platform InvestorGain. The grey market premium (GMP) indicates unofficial market sentiment ahead of listing but does not guarantee the listing price or investor returns.

Read Also: Who is Tejas Sudarshan? AI startup founder who got 90 seconds to pitch to PM Modi on Chennai Metro

The IPO comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 500 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 69.90 lakh shares worth Rs 202 crore. While the company will receive the proceeds from the fresh issue, the OFS will allow existing shareholders to sell part of their holdings.

Fusion CX has set the price band at Rs 275–289 per share. Retail investors can apply for a minimum of 51 shares, translating into a minimum investment of Rs 14,739 at the upper end of the price band.

The final amount payable will depend on the price at which shares are allotted, subject to the applicable IPO application rules.

The IPO will open on October 14 and close on October 16. The basis of allotment is expected to be finalised on October 19, while the company's shares are scheduled to list on the stock exchanges on October 22.

Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd is the book-running lead manager for the issue, while KFin Technologies Ltd is the registrar.

Fusion CX plans to use part of the fresh issue proceeds to repay or prepay certain outstanding borrowings of the company and its subsidiaries, including select step-down subsidiaries.

The company also intends to invest in its step-down subsidiaries, Omind Technologies Inc. and Omind Technologies Private Limited, to upgrade information technology tools, including Arya and MindVoice.

The proposed investments are aimed at strengthening the company's technology capabilities and operational infrastructure.

Check IPO News Here

Fusion CX reported an improvement in its financial performance in FY26, with both total income and profit after tax (PAT) rising from the previous financial year.

The company's total income increased 37 percent to Rs 1,852 crore in FY26 from Rs 1,352 crore in FY25. Profit after tax more than doubled to Rs 170 crore from Rs 74 crore, registering a growth of around 130 percent.

The growth in income and profitability will be among the key financial metrics investors may assess while evaluating the IPO.

About Fusion CX Ltd

Incorporated in 2004, Fusion CX is a technology-driven customer experience (CX) solutions provider that offers multilingual services across voice, chat, email, social media and messaging platforms.

Its services include customer acquisition, customer support, collections, retention and technical assistance, alongside digital solutions. Through its technology subsidiary, Omind Technologies, the company develops artificial intelligence-powered tools for customer engagement, marketing, quality automation and workforce management.
